prior_art.edition: Lorenzo de' Medici, Lettere V (1480-1481, ed. Mallett, Google Books zB9dAAAAMAAJ) opened in Chrome: p. 257 is Lorenzo's reply to Ridolfi of 3 July 1481 ('Di quello mi scrivete in cifra non so che mi credere ... non e seguito altro', n. 13); n. 13 says Ridolfi's letter of 27 June was written entirely in cipher and concerned the latest Genoese events, citing 'MAP, XLVIII, 63 e Sig., X, VIII, 4, III, c. 51v'. Sig., X, VIII = Signori, Dieci di Balia, Otto di Pratica, Legazioni e Commissarie, Missive e Responsive (sigle list p. xiv), a register holding copies of Ridolfi's legation letters (e.g. 21 May: MAP XLVIII 77 and Sig. X VIII 4 III cc. 38v-39r, p. 204). Lettere VI (1481-1482, CSBdAAAAMAAJ) p. 11 uses its content: 'Roberto di Sanseverino ed il duca del Monferrato erano nettamente favorevoli ad appoggiare gli esuli (T. Ridolfi a Lorenzo, 27 giugno, MAP, XLVIII, 63 e Sig., X, VIII, 4, III, c. 51v ...)'.
prior_art.literature: web searches in n18 (Ridolfi 1481 cifra; Sig. X VIII series): only a Warwick index of Ridolfi's 1481 letters to the Otto; no cryptologic study of this letter.

2376.closed: the plaintext is on record: the register copy ASF Signori, Dieci, Otto, Legazioni e Commissarie, Missive e Responsive 4, III, c. 51v (archive only, not seen) is cited beside MAP XLVIII 63 in Lettere V p. 257 n. 13 and VI p. 11, and Mallett gives its content (Genoese events; Roberto da Sanseverino and the marquis of Monferrato favouring the exiles). Not printed in full; the register leaf would give the text.

2375.unvetted: edition partly answers but does not settle cipher versus hard hand. Lettere II (1474-1478, ed. Fubini, 1hpdAAAAMAAJ, opened in Chrome): p. 432 cites 'T. Soderini a Lorenzo, 17 novembre, MAP, XLVIII, 13' and paraphrases it as ordinary content (the Sienese accepting an orator, Nov 1477), with no mention of cipher; 'XLVIII, 11', '12', '14', '15' probes hit only index pages and unrelated notes (pp. 96, 409, 412, 417, 529-560); 'Soderini' 20 pages, 'cifra' 9 pages (75, 180, 276 ...), 'gergo' 0. The editor's date (17 Nov) conflicts with the lead's 'luglio 1477' for doc. 13, so the identification needs checking. Leans not cipher (editor read doc. 13 as prose; n18 found ordinary Italian vowel patterns, no signs), but a not_cipher verdict needs a line-by-line reading of docs 11-15 at full size.
